```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if 30 <= (r - item) <= 45 else 0) - (20 if 8 <= (r - item) <= 22 else 0) + (15 if (r - item) <= 3 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Triple rule: +20 if leftover in [30, 45], -20 if leftover in [8, 22], +15 if leftover<=3, on Best-Fit score.
